summary: This tool statically recompiles PlayStation 2 executables into WebAssembly so they can run in browsers. It is a C++ CLI project that produces a WASM runtime bundle and does not require an API key. It is aimed at developers wanting to bring legacy PS2 games to the web, leveraging static recompilation rather than emulation. The main strength is its novel focus on PS2 binaries, but the broken installation and lack of documentation limit immediate usability.
